text:
incident-bot: P0 - streaming cluster 'decode-prod' reporting repeated CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY during decode path. (~7% request drops, multiple nodes). Auto-escalate to oncall.

Maria (oncall): I'm on it, thanks. seeing escalating 5xxs in the dashboard, tailing logs now. any correlated deploys? :eyes:

Kevin (platform): No deploys in the last 30m. Autoscaler shows nodes healthy but processes crashing and restarting. I can pull the container logs and CUDA traces.

Jess (sre): Paging Kevin + Maria. Customer impact: 12 tenants hitting 500s, some streaming sessions truncated. We should throttle or enforce max_tokens at the proxy while root cause is investigated.

Maria (oncall): Agreed. Samir, can runtime accept a config override to apply a hard max_tokens cap per request? We need a quick kill switch.

Samir (eng-runtime): We have a feature-flagged proxy override. I can flip a global cap to 1024 tokens for streaming requests in the next minute. That will drop long-running runaway generations.

Nora (mlops): Note: some customers intentionally send >2k tokens for long generations (few customers will be affected). We should warn support and enable fallback variant (smaller quantized model) for affected routes.

Maria (oncall): Do it. Apply global cap, then route overflow to fallback model. Post a message when done.

Samir (eng-runtime): Running the rollout now. command:
```bash
# flip the proxy cap feature flag
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \"https://ops-api.redwood.internal/fflags/override\" -d '{"global_streaming_max_tokens":1024}'
```

Samir (eng-runtime): Done. FF override applied, 100% rollout. Observability: tokens distribution shows tail trimmed.

ops-bot: config-change: global_streaming_max_tokens=1024 by Samir (eng-runtime) at 1729800087

Maria (oncall): I'm seeing immediate drop in OOM spikes on node pool decode-prod-1. Request drops falling from 7% -> 2% in the last 2 minutes. Good.

Kevin (platform): Collected container log snippet from node decode-prod-1: 
```
2024-10-04T15:26:30Z runtime[pid=2112]: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: allocation failed for size=1.2GiB
2024-10-04T15:26:30Z runtime[pid=2112]: traceback: decode_loop -> kv_cache -> cudaMalloc
2024-10-04T15:26:31Z runtime[pid=2112]: process exited with code 137
```

Kevin (platform): Looks like some requests had mis-specified max_tokens in the client (negative or huge). Proxy cap helped but we should identify offending clients. I'll dump recent request headers for >1024 attempts.

Jess (sre): Also temporarily increased circuit-breaker threshold and enabled per-tenant rate-limits for streaming endpoints to reduce burst pressure. Command used: `/runbook apply streaming-rate-limits --tenants=high-usage --limit=20rps`

Nora (mlops): Spotted a malformed JSON in a recent batch ingestion that set `max_tokens: 999999999` due to int parsing bug in a 3rd-party SDK. We should notify the customer and add validation on the API surface.

Maria (oncall): Noted. Samir, can we add server-side validation to cap request-specified max_tokens at 20000 absolute and reject obviously bad values with 400?

Samir (eng-runtime): Yes, I'll open a hotfix PR for request validation and prioritize it. In the short term, the proxy cap plus rate-limits reduced OOMs.

Kevin (platform): I restarted the 3 affected containers after cordoning the nodes for a rolling restart (no full node reboot). Recovered processes are stable.

Maria (oncall): Customer impact summary for ops: ~12 tenants saw intermittent 5xxs in last 20m, estimated 450 failed requests, no data loss. Key affected tenant: Acme Corp reported truncated streaming sessions in web UI. Support notified.

Jess (sre): Creating incident ticket and setting severity P1 -> P2 as mitigations holding. Will track until postmortem.

incident-bot: incident status changed to: mitigated (temporary controls applied).

Maria (oncall): Next steps: Samir to open validation PR and deploy; Nora to notify the few customers who relied on huge token counts; Kevin to run a postmortem checklist (node-level heap dump + GPU counters); Jess to draft incident summary for internal ops.

Samir (eng-runtime): PR opened: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/1423 - adds server-side max_tokens validation and logs suspicious token requests to audit stream.

Nora (mlops): I'll reach out to the 3 affected customers and advise them to patch SDK or cap client-side tokens. Draft message ready.

Kevin (platform): Uploading GPU metrics and the heap dump to artifacts: s3://redwood-incidents/1729800000/ ; added nvprof traces.

Maria (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving this thread open for final notes. After action items done, we'll move to full postmortem. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: note: follow-up task created - INCIDENT-172980: server-side validation + postmortem (assignees: Samir, Kevin, Nora, Jess)

Maria (oncall): Last update: metrics stable for 30m, dropping to baseline. Marking as resolved for immediate customer impact. Will include remediation timeline in postmortem.

incident-bot: incident closed at 1729800450 by Maria (oncall)
